question.html:
Negative charge carriers travel counter-clockwise in a circular coil that lies in the plane of the page.

The coil is in a uniform magnetic field directed into the page.

What is the magnetic effect on the coil?

[1]

  1. The coil will rotate clockwise in the plane of the paper.
  2. The coil will rotate counter-clockwise in the plane of the paper.
  3. The diameter of the coil will tend to increase.
  4. The diameter of the coil will tend to decrease.
